title: I made a psychological horror game about k-pop idol industry
author: Secret-Particular-94
selftext: Hi, I made a psychological horror game about k-pop idol industry with AI. I would love to have some play testers would be great if someone could play and provide me some feedback. DM and I'll send you the build

comments.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
comments.body:
What AI did you use to make this?  
I think you would get testers more easily with a simple itch link

replies.author: Secret-Particular-94
replies.body: claude and some other stuff. maybe too heavy for itch link?

comments.author: Individual_Ad_4899
comments.body: Very creative concept. Love to see where you take this.

comments.author: AdStreet4350
comments.body:
There are some really good ideas, but also a few things that don’t work as well. The visuals still look a bit too AI-generated to me, especially stuff like the “Smile Prettier” text 🥱

Other than that, the concept itself is pretty cool. It’s mainly the art direction that still feels too AI-generated.

replies.author: Secret-Particular-94
replies.body: oh i see. this is just a trailer ai made. i think the game is better i supposed? i made like 15 endings so. this is why i need game testers lol

comments.author: DoctaRoboto
comments.body: I think the potential is great...if you are a fan of Satoshi Kon, you know what I mean. If this is some shitty jump scare fest or some Doki Doki Literature Club with idols, then you are going to miss a nice opportunity to make a good denpa game.

replies.author: Secret-Particular-94
replies.body: hmm i was inspired by doki but nah not just like doki. second time making game with ai but I had this idea for a while this why i need playtesters lol

replies.author: DoctaRoboto
replies.body: Then I suggest you, instead of following the hyper-predictable trope of a yandere breaking the 4th wall, check what the master of psychological horror did with Paranoia Agent and especially Perfect Blue, a masterpiece that inspired Black Swan among other works.

replies.author: Secret-Particular-94
replies.body: thank you if you'd like to playtest let me know
